mentions.name: YouTube image-extracting summary website
mentions.description: This website extracts useful images from YouTube videos and produces summaries that include those images, intended to handle cases where text-only summaries fall short (e.g., really new ideas or bar graphs). It also draws boxes and arrows on top of the images for extra clarity.
mentions.problem: Text-only video summaries don't work for really new ideas and can't show bar graphs, so images need to be included.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A website that extracts useful images from youtube videos. It would be a summary but includes the images because "text only" doesn't work for really new ideas. and 
"text only" doesn't show bar graphs. And I think I will make it also make it draw boxes and arrows on top of the images for extra clarity.
